name: Take a Hint
source:
Yuuta and Toge are on a study date, however the two would like nothing more than to be a little affectionate. Can either take a hint?
That's up to you!

[From [url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/take-a-hint]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
忧太与棘正在进行一场学习约会，可两人心里其实都巴不得能趁机亲热温存一番。他们之中有谁能读懂对方的暗示吗？
一切全看你的选择！

[摘自[url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/take-a-hint]itch.io[/url]]
